title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission on Issuing the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission on Several Issues concerning the Handling of Securities and Futures Crimes
keywords_en: securities; handling illegal and criminal cases involving securities and futures
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security

China Securities Regulatory Commission

Notice on Issuing the "Opinions of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission on Several Issues Concerning the Handling of Securities and Futures Illegal and Criminal Cases"

CSRC Issuance [2011] No. 30

To the High People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, and Public Security Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court and the Military Procuratorate of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; the People's Procuratorate and Public Security Bureau of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps; and the Regulatory Bureaus of the China Securities Regulatory Commission in all provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government, and cities with independent planning status:

In order to resolve some prominent issues encountered in recent years in the handling of securities and futures illegal and criminal cases, and to legally punish securities and futures crimes, the "Opinions of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission on Several Issues Concerning the Handling of Securities and Futures Illegal and Criminal Cases" are hereby issued to you for implementation.

Any problems encountered during implementation shall be promptly reported to the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission.

April 27, 2011

Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Handling of Securities and Futures Illegal and Criminal Cases

In order to strengthen the work of handling securities and futures illegal and criminal cases, improve the linkage mechanism between administrative law enforcement and criminal justice, and further effectively punish securities and futures crimes in accordance with the law, the following opinions are put forward:

1. When a securities regulatory institution, in the course of handling securities and futures illegal cases that may be transferred to the public security organs for investigation, in accordance with the relevant provisions of administrative organs on transferring suspected criminal cases, and after going through the approval procedures, may consult with the public security organs to assist in inquiring about and copying the household registration, immigration information, and other materials of the investigated subjects, and take border control, reporting, and filing measures against the relevant persons involved in accordance with the relevant provisions. When a securities regulatory institution makes a request to the public security organ, it shall specify the specific matters for which assistance is required and provide the case circumstances and relevant materials.

2. Where a securities regulatory institution, in handling a securities or futures illegal case, finds the case to be of major significance, complex, or difficult, it may consult with the public security organ for reference opinions on the nature of the case, evidence, and other issues; where there is evidence indicating that a person who is likely to be suspected of a crime may abscond or destroy evidence, the securities regulatory institution shall promptly notify the public security organ; if a crime is suspected, the public security organ shall promptly file the case for investigation.

3. The securities regulatory institution and the public security organ shall establish and improve a coordination and consultation mechanism. Before a securities regulatory institution transfers a major, complex, or difficult suspected securities or futures criminal case to the public security organ, it shall initiate the coordination and consultation mechanism to discuss issues such as the determination of the nature of the act, the application of charges for the case, and the jurisdiction of the case.

4. Where public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts, in the course of handling suspected securities or futures criminal cases, may consult with the securities regulatory institution to assign professional personnel to cooperate in the work and assist in reviewing and copying relevant professional materials. The securities regulatory institution may, based on the needs of the judicial organs in handling the case, issue identification opinions to the judicial organs on the securities and futures professional issues involved in the case in accordance with the law.

5. Judicial organs shall promptly review the material evidence, documentary evidence, expert conclusions, audio-visual materials, on-site records, and other evidence transferred by the securities regulatory institution together with the case file and decide whether to file the case; evidence transferred with the case file that has been verified through legal procedures may be used as the basis for concluding the case.

6. When a securities regulatory institution transfers evidence to a public security organ in accordance with the relevant provisions of an administrative organ on transferring suspected criminal cases, it shall prepare an evidence transfer inventory, which shall be signed and confirmed by the handling officers of both parties, affixed with official seals, and the relevant evidence shall be transferred together with the evidence transfer inventory.

7. For crimes involving a large number of victims in securities and futures cases, on the premise that the evidence already collected can sufficiently prove the basic facts of the crime, the public security organ may collect and retrieve relevant evidence such as documentary evidence, victim statements, and witness testimony within the scope of the investigated subjects at a certain ratio.

8. Where electronic data such as securities and futures entrustment records and transaction records, registration, depository and settlement materials retained by stock exchanges, futures exchanges, securities registration and settlement institutions, futures margin monitoring institutions, as well as securities companies and futures companies, are used as evidence, the data provider shall record the relevant original data on an electronic disc or other medium, and specify information such as the method of production, time of production, and producer, and the copy producer and the holder of the original electronic data shall sign or affix their seals.

9. Where an issuer, listed company, or other information disclosure obligor publishes an information disclosure announcement on the information disclosure media designated by the securities regulatory institution, on the website of the information disclosure obligor or the stock exchange, the printed copy or the electronic disc made therefrom, after being verified to be correct and having its source, producer, place of production, etc., explained, may be used as criminal evidence, unless there is other evidence proving that the content of the printed copy or the disc is inconsistent with the announcement information.

10. The first-instance trial of suspected securities and futures criminal cases shall be under the jurisdiction of the intermediate people's court, the people's procuratorate at the same level shall initiate public prosecutions, and public security organs at the prefectural (city) level or above shall be responsible for filing and investigating the case.
